## Executive Summary
Wenceslaus Dsilva has spent two decades at the forefront of digital engineering and technology leadership. His track record includes:
- Scaling consumer, enterprise, and fintech applications from early prototype to millions of active users.
- Migrating monolithic systems to serverless and event-driven microservices architectures, delivering up to 85% reduction in execution latency and 40-60% cloud cost reductions.
- Pioneering applied AI/ML in production: Computer vision for authentication, multilingual speech synthesis, automated content pipelines, and semantic search.
- Leading cross-functional engineering organizations across distributed topologies.

## Architectural Case Studies
- [Rooftop Case Study](https://w1d.pro/work/rooftop): Serverless transformation, computer vision seller verification, and AI-driven multilingual storytelling delivering 85% runtime reduction and 60% engagement uplift.
- [Food Darzee Case Study](https://w1d.pro/work/food-darzee): Scalable ERP modernization, automated kitchen routing, and logistics optimization for a high-volume custom nutrition platform.
- [OnFees Case Study](https://w1d.pro/work/onfees): High-throughput educational fee processing platform with bank reconciliation and zero-downtime ledger consistency.
- [IndieFolio Case Study](https://w1d.pro/work/indiefolio): Color-quantization search engine and high-concurrency creative network scaled across India's design community.
- [ePaisa Case Study](https://w1d.pro/work/epaisa): PCI DSS-compliant mobile POS payment engine with offline transaction queuing and hardware peripheral abstraction.
- [TCS & WNS Case Study](https://w1d.pro/work/tcs-wns): Enterprise data automation, ETL pipeline engineering, and legacy modernization.
- [CouponDunia Case Study](https://w1d.pro/work/coupon-dunia): High-velocity coupon syndication platform serving millions of monthly shoppers.

- Machine Learning & AI: Computer Vision (TensorFlow.js), SageMaker, NLP, Multilingual Voice AI, LLM System Integration.
- Leadership: Technical Strategy, Team Mentorship, Agile/Kanban Governance, Budget Management, Vendor Negotiation, Executive Stakeholder Alignment.
